ModMetaData.name: Replace Stuff (1.7 Port)
ModMetaData.author: Uuugggg (alextd), MemeGoddess, Hexnet111; 1.7 port: Jonathon Taylor
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld 1.7 port of Replace Stuff, built from reviewed source in a public repo.
Replace the stuff that a thing is made from, for example replace a wood wall with a stone wall. The mod does not deconstruct and rebuild: it keeps the building and replaces the material in place. Rooms stay closed, freezers stay cold and workbenches keep their bills. Blueprints can also go over rock and fog, coolers and vents can go into walls, and bridges go down under buildings on water.
Base: Workshop "Replace Stuff - Continued" (3526354009, updated 2026-10-17), with the Hexnet111 performance fork ported by hand up to commit c153cdb10b2584d68d8e50ac73d304a2e8e85944. The port clears the fork's replacement cache at each new or loaded game.
Credits: Uuugggg (alextd), the original author; MemeGoddess, "Replace Stuff - Continued"; Hexnet111, the performance fork. MIT licence.
Source: - Original: https://github.com/alextd/RimWorld-ReplaceStuff - Upstream: https://github.com/MemeGoddess/RimWorld-ReplaceStuff - Fork: https://github.com/Hexnet111/RimWorld-ReplaceStuff-Performance-Patch - This port: https://github.com/j0nathontayl0r/rimworld-local-mods
Turn off "Replace Stuff - Continued" before you turn on this mod.
